author: harness:claude-code

patch.value: Disposition the test-only escape hatch published through the ./cli entrypoint: 86 internal functions are consumer-visible API with no support intent

src/cli/main.ts exports _testOnly, an object of 86 internal helpers, and package.json publishes ./cli with dist/cli/main.d.ts. Consumers can import and type-check against every one of them. The SDK side already treats this as a governed decision: _testOnlyCliContracts carries a named exclusion reason. The ./cli side has never been dispositioned.

The published ./cli declaration either stops exposing _testOnly or the exposure carries a recorded reason in the surface snapshot's exclusion vocabulary; pm's own tests continue to reach the helpers through source imports rather than the package export; The chosen disposition is written into docs/SDK.md next to the executable_entry classification; A change to the set of exposed helpers is a classified surface change either way
The published CLI entrypoint exposes only what the project intends to support.
It exposes runPmCli plus 86 unsupported internal helpers, typed and resolvable by any consumer.

message: Split from pm-suhxny so the governance fix lands without silently blessing the leak
